purpose: Ensure shell-socket Gateway bridge modules preserve the universal trace spine while keeping Shell projection and ingress authority outside the fragile legacy Shell.

trace_identity_rule.single_trace_id: Every shell-socket Gateway bridge must preserve the incoming trace_id when present and emit the same trace_id in every response payload and nested gateway metadata envelope.
trace_identity_rule.gateway_mints_only_at_boundary: Gateway code may mint a trace_id only at the initial Gateway boundary when one is missing; bridge modules must not fork or replace a supplied trace_id.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared bridge module emits trace_id.
Projection bridge modules emit gateway_projection metadata with route_id, capability_id, projection_owner, gateway_owner, and bounded=true.
Ingress bridge modules emit gateway_ingress metadata with route_id, capability_id, authority_owner, gateway_owner, and request byte budgeting.
Bridge modules must not introduce raw trace, workflow, execution observation, or raw tool payload fields into default Shell socket responses.
